title: A simple method of computing Riemann-type integrals
summary: The "Riemann-type integrals" of the title are not a single new integral, but the family of classical constructions -- Riemann, Riemann-Stieltjes, Young-Kondurar, complex-analytic, and Itô -- unified by one elementary method. We give a simple argument computing the Riemann integral of a polynomial directly, establishing the fundamental theorem of calculus for polynomials and then continuous functions.
